verdict.rationale: Workable's ReadMe-hosted reference explicitly disables OpenAPI spec download ("show_openapi_download":"disabled"), and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returns 404. The llms.txt index, markdown docs pages and MCP server are related surfaces, but none is a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
